entries.t: <FACE:6E>Heh heh heh… You fell<NL>for it once again…
<FACE:75>Cough… we fought you<NL>one by one to stall…<WAIT>Meanwhile we took the<NL>Cluster's boosters<WAIT>The plan: make taking<NL>it back impossible!
<FACE:75>The plan, of course…<NL>gah… was mine!
<FACE:7C>Hold it!<NL><WAIT>Don't forget who got<NL>the supplies for it!
<FACE:71>Say what! My Block<NL>stalled them longest!
<FACE:73>…All the officers…<NL>…will face you…

<FACE:6C>Heh heh heh… Kirika<NL>is right<WAIT>We five officers will<NL>take you on!<WAIT>You want the arm freed<NL>to launch the Cluster<WAIT>but I'm afraid this is<NL>as far as you go!<WAIT>The arm cannot be<NL>released!!
<FACE:75>Cough… by now we know<NL>how strong you are!<WAIT>Don't think it'll go<NL>like before… gah!
<FACE:6D>Ngh… we've disgraced<NL>ourselves again!<WAIT>…In that case…<WAIT><FACE:59>Enough! That's quite<NL>enough, Nyuudou!<NL>
<FACE:59>I was a fool to expect<NL>anything of you lot!<WAIT>I expect nothing now!<NL>A waste of oxygen!!
<FACE:78>Eeek! L-Leader, sir…<NL>cough…<WAIT><FACE:75>Anything but that!<NL>It ruins my health…<WAIT><FACE:59>Eeeeeenough!<NL>Silence!!
<FACE:09>…T-that's awful…
<FACE:09>They're frozen…<NL>Will they be okay?
<FACE:0F>Yeah, it seems these<NL>capsules<WAIT>are cold sleep pods<NL>for deep space travel<WAIT>They look safe enough…
<FACE:02>Good… evil officers,<NL>but not bad people<WAIT><FACE:07>Heh… <PLAYER>, you're<NL>soft-hearted as ever
<FACE:00>Hiyori, weren't you<NL>sad about it too…<WAIT><FACE:59>Hey! A mystery man's<NL>here! Look at me!!
<FACE:01>Never mind, our job is<NL>freeing the Cluster!<WAIT><FACE:15>Yeah! New characters<NL>just muddle the plot!<WAIT><FACE:1A>Best to ignore him and<NL>push right through!
<FACE:00>So then, quick, to the<NL>arm controls!<WAIT><FACE:59>Oops! I'd forgotten!<NL>
<FACE:59>Bwa ha ha ha! I've cut<NL>that room's controls!<WAIT>How's that!<NL>
<FACE:59>Now you'll have to pay<NL>attention to me!<WAIT>Come up by the lift in<NL>that room!
